last_summary: Trajectory Mapper run 3 (gear 1, free deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash; no gear-2 credit fallback). +1 trajectory note — 'Form Waves and Radiesthesia' (navigator/trajectory/2026-09-23-form-waves-radiesthesia.md; index.json updated, 2 -> 3 entries). THE LINE HAS NINE CLAIMS UNDER TWO WORDS AND SITS ON SIX RUNGS. REPLICATED: the rod/pendulum response is real, involuntary and operator-produced (Chevreul's arm-support demonstration 1812-1854, full English translation in-corpus; Carpenter names the ideomotor effect 1852) — the tradition never disputed this, Turenne quotes it as his own premise ('the human body is the detector; the instrument merely makes visible'), which is why its instrument can never be its own control. REFUTED (strong-claim level), SIX RECORDS IN 92 YEARS, FOUR COUNTRIES: Pouchet 1934 Lyon coded packets 0/4 (death cap read 'indifferent'; the demonstrator PASSED on species he already knew, then Pouchet relayed the full Mycophage protocol and formally PROPOSED the blinded commission that NEVER MET — the archive's cleanest case of a tradition recording its own miss and naming the experiment it declined to run); Costérisant 1937 ~200 water-supply projects ZERO verifiable successes + 3/3 prospective tracking failures + the still-load-bearing 1937 confound (do not count an indication 'very close to an apparent spring' — the digging manufactures the success; the INRS 2026 abstract says the same thing: 'groundwater is often ubiquitous... what constitutes a genuine detection?'); Munich 1986-88 43 dowsers / 843 trials chance, 457 of 500 eliminated at the LOOSE first stage, and the 'six good dowsers' residue reproduced from a RANDOM-NUMBER GENERATOR alone (Napier 1999, PHACT) — externally re-verified this run that the rig was inspected by a professional magician and that the German government FUNDED it hoping to VALIDATE dowsing, so the null is not a hostile test; Kassel 1991 chance; Argenton 2007 1/7, 2/10, 4/32 against a pre-registered 1% criterion with the practitioners setting their own separation distance, instrument and (in one series) sample — 'you tested it wrong' does not survive that design. ATTEMPTED, VERDICT UNREAD (the live rung): the buried-water-line claim. INRS/Bordeleau 54 participants (27 experienced / 27 novices) on a 25-cell grid over buried iron and plastic pipes, empty or water-filled, saline or fresh, stagnant or flowing, rod type tracked, CO-DESIGNED WITH A PRACTISING DOWSWER, reported at EGU26 Vienna 3-8 May 2026 (doi 10.5194/egusphere-egu26-3985). VERIFIED THIS RUN FROM THE EXTERNAL RECORD: the abstract says 'we present the final results' and IS publicly retrievable, but NO numeric table is published anywhere in the public record as of 2026-09-23 — so the corpus's 'test complete, verdict pending' grading is correct and should not be softened either way. Also verified: the study is funded by an FRQNT Engagement grant 2022-2025 ('Sourciers et sourcières des temps modernes'), i.e. ENGAGEMENT research, not a debunk program — a nuance that cuts in the tradition's favour and changes no number. NEWEST CARD: Dossier 035 (Blind Water-Line Location, filed 2026-09-23, ~$20-40, one afternoon) — the queue's FIRST card with (a) ground truth, (b) a NON-DOWSY CONTROL ARM, (c) a pre-registered key-holder; 20 blind direction trials vs a 50% baseline + >=5 marked points scored as perpendicular distance from the true hose path + 10 static sham trials; it states in its own body that 'the hose is not a water vein'. SPECIFIED PROTOCOL, ZERO ATTEMPTS: earth-energy networks (Dossier 005, ~$5, inter-rater, NO ground truth — a weaker design than 035 sets); geometric form affects a living system (Dossier 011, ~$5-10 — note its endpoint IS the rod's reading, so it inherits the uncalibrated readout); neutral-pendulum discrimination (Dossier 034, ~$10-20, carries the transposable OPEN POSITIVE-CONTROL ARM whose failure makes a blind arm INCONCLUSIVE, not a refutation). THE READOUT (Bovis) IS THE LINE'S REAL HOLE: part (c) of the claim — scale stability — is ALREADY FALSE ON THE TRADITION'S OWN RECORD (human baseline 6,500 -> 12,500 UB in 2014, +92%, with no instrument change; dials 18,000 -> 60,000 -> 120,000; Earth now quoted at 2.39M UB climbing 2-3,000/day; ACMOS inside the tradition calls a 400,000 UB goji reading 'totalement loufoque'), while parts (a) and (b) have NEVER BEEN TESTED. Dossier 032 (~$0-30, two printouts) tests the ruler with an Arm C2 dial-swap ratio R = UB on a silently x2-rescaled dial / UB on the standard dial: R~1 defensible, R~2 = the corpus's own stated mechanism 're-label the ruler and the pendulum will adapt itself' caught in the act at a kitchen table. THE QUESTION THIS RUN PUTS FORWARD: does the number stay put or double with the ruler? NOT ANSWERABLE FROM THE CORPUS (the two documented attempts test discrimination and sorting, never the ruler; the Bovis provenance chain is still listed as open scouting work). STRUCTURAL FINDING — INVERSION: this is the archive's most-TESTED line (6 of 21 validations, the highest density of any family) and its least-DOCUMENTED (meta_counts['Radionics, Radiesthesia & Shape Power'] = 57 of 27 categories — the smallest real science bucket in the archive, against 64,634 'Challenges to the Standard Model', 868 'Water Structure & Memory', 271 'Sacred & Projective Geometry'). Its evidence is procedural, not bibliographic.
